newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Colston to make announcement.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Colston to make announcement.

text.p: Embattled Australian senator Mal Colston will make a major statement at 9.00 a.m. (2300 GMT) at The Wesley Uniting Church Private Hospital in Brisbane, the hospital said on Thursday in a statement.
Colston is under police investigation over claims he abused travel expenses and the government has called for his resignation as deputy president of the Senate.
The Labor Opposition, from which Colston defected to become an independent in August last year, has called for Colston's resignation from the Senate.

Prime Minister John Howard's year-old conservative government does not have a Senate majority and has relied on support from Colston and another independent to pass key reforms, including budget cuts, through the Senate.
